candidates.requirement: After a successful copy, continue to emit the parsed event and process the emitted output.
candidates.target_route: For a valid YAML input, yaml_parser_parse produces an event; copy_event initializes its copy and returns 1; the target tests that return value before yaml_emitter_emit.
candidates.failure_condition: The true result takes goto delete_parser, so the emitter call and output reparse are skipped.
candidates.alternative_paths: Every successful copy takes the same exit; failed parsing or copying cannot provide an equivalent emission route.
